subject: MSEM: Level 2 variable indirect effects on Level1 variables

messages.author: 8851725a1a14f6e1
messages.subject: MSEM: Level 2 variable indirect effects on Level1 variables
parts:
Hello. I am new to multi-level structural equation modelling in lavaan and would appreciate any help I can get from this group. I hypothesized a school level variable having an indirect effect on individual level variables: that is, Principal support having an indirect effect on individual student motivation through teacher motivation and practices. For example, in the code below, I tried to get mediation effect in Level 1 and Level 2.   However, I what I really want to do is to find out whether there is a mediation between level 2 variable (e.g., TG_NSL) and level 1 variable (e.g. student motivation). Is there a way to do this in lavaan? Thanks.

------Code sample----
model<-'
Level: Within
 sautmot=~f*SMOT9+g*SMOT10+h*SMOT11+i*SMOT12+j*SMOT13+k*SMOT14+l*SMOT15+m*SMOT16
 nst=~aa*NST1+bb*NST2+cc*NST3+dd*NST4+ee*NST5+ff*NST6+gg*NST7+hh*NST8+ii*NST9+jj*NST10+kk*NST11+ll*NST12
 sautmot=~a1*nst
 EXPGRADE~b1*sautmot+c1*nst
Level: Between
 nst=~aa*NST1+bb*NST2+cc*NST3+dd*NST4+ee*NST5+ff*NST6+gg*NST7+hh*NST8+ii*NST9+jj*NST10+kk*NST11+ll*NST12
 TG_AUTMOT~a2*TG_NSL
 nst~b2*TG_AUTMOT+c2*TG_NSL
 ind1:=a2*b2'

messages.subject: Re: MSEM: Level 2 variable indirect effects on Level1 variables
parts: what I really want to do is to find out whether there is a mediation between level 2 variable (e.g., TG_NSL) and level 1 variable (e.g. student motivation).

Level-2 variables can only (be) explain(ed by) Level-2 components of Level-1 variables.  If any of the variables in your mediation model are Level-2 only, then the mediation can only occur at Level 2.

http://quantpsy.org/pubs/preacher_zyphur_zhang_2010.pdf
